The nil-@topic_view concern also doesn't trigger: when `topic_id` is nil the controller does `render 'loading'`, so best.html.erb is never rendered without @topic_view. The remaining suggestion (use a ternary) is a pure style preference.

adjudication.rationale: In app/views/embed/best.html.erb the header block ends with `<%- end if %>`, which emits Ruby `end if` with no condition. That is invalid Ruby syntax and would cause the template to fail to compile/render when the `best` view is used. The claim about `@topic_view` being nil in this view is not supported by the controller (it renders `loading` when no topic_id), but the malformed ERB closing is a real defect in the diff.
